answer.text: Northbridge Library is open on Saturdays. It closes at 8 p.m. on weekdays. It opened in 1998.

sources.title: Northbridge Library visitor guide
sources.text: Northbridge Library is open on Saturdays from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. On weekdays, the library closes at 6 p.m. The source does not state when the library opened.
